translations.web: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you;’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
translations.bsb: But if He should say, ‘I do not delight in you,’ then here I am; let Him do to me whatever seems good to Him.”
translations.kjv: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.
